title: Totem animation
description: A lightweight plugin to play the totem of undying animation (with any model) to a specified player.
body:
### A new command
This plugin adds a command /totemanimation. It allows you to play the totem of undying animation with any model to a specified player.
###  Usage:
To use this command you have to specify the player and model.
```
/totemanimation <player> <model>
```

### Examples: 
```
/totemanimation den5iiik diamond
```
Plays the totem of undying animation with diamond model.
![diamond](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1091f3df53e8132c9321423638abc914a06c8fc1_0.webp)  
```
/totemanimation den5iiik rp:model
```
Plays the totem of undying animation with custom resource pack model.
![rp:model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8cb3c830c3ba28867eba63893b5ee695d25795e6_0.webp)
